### The problem

I have several cameras, added over time (G3 pro, Ai Theta, G3 & G4 Instant). My first camera allowed me to disable recording and live viewing by a "privacy" switch. These controls are no longer available in my Home Assistant. At the moment only the g3 pro and Ai Theta are connected.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.9.7

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Unifi Protect

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/unifiprotect/
